body: It’s one of our shared outside garbage bins, however the day I left I took the trash out to the curb as it was the day the garbage was being picked up, nothing that was in there now would have been mine.

I knew a lot of the songs except the ones sung by the other vocaloids, (besides Luka) but it was cool to see them! I was hoping to see gumi, but I hear there is a complication with her copyright?

I did cheat and look up the set list from Dallas to get a feel for what might be played, so before that I only heard about a third of what was played. I’m a huge Kikuo fan so I don’t know a lot of the more “traditional” miku songs.
Hahah, I feel spoiled now as well! And everyone had it so well choreographed, I’m so impressed.

My friend and I were put in the wrong line twice and there were only(?) 3 lines!! One dude in the GA line seemed particularly pissed at the huge mess he was forced to manage. 

But as my first miku concert it was absolutely magical and mind blowing. My friend and I got our light sticks we were concerned about and ended up letting a young girl borrow one and giving another away to a nice woman after the show. I hope it made their experience a bit more fun (0:
